import datetime, re

# Login tokens (re-derive to be safe)
venmo_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

phone_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='2738013302', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

# Resolve Robert from phone contacts
all_contacts=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    i += 1

robert_contacts=[c for c in all_contacts if ('robert' in (c.get('first_name','') or '').lower() or 'robert' in (c.get('last_name','') or '').lower())]
print('phone_robert_contacts', [(c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'), c.get('phone_number')) for c in robert_contacts])

# Map phone contact emails to Venmo users
resolved_venmo_users=[]
for c in robert_contacts:
    email = c.get('email')
    if not email:
        continue
    # paginate search_users
    j=0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=j, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        resolved_venmo_users.extend(page)
        j += 1

print('resolved_venmo_users', resolved_venmo_users)

# Unique by email
uniq={}
for u in resolved_venmo_users:
    uniq[u.get('email')]=u
print('uniq_venmo_emails', list(uniq.keys()))
